doc.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: She loves me. She’s a good lady. She’s a really good lady. I was very proud to be a part of her Legends Ball. And she also does very good work. She’s a good – she’s got a big heart. Not just a good heart. She’s got a big heart, and she is always there. When it matters, when it’s important, she – and she does good stuff. She put out some decent movies, and she put [out] the plays. Not just the television show. I’m anxious to see what OWN [Oprah Winfrey Network] is going to be, how the news network show is going to be – the network, period. Not the show. She’s going to – that will be interesting to watch.
